profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Earlitec Diagnostics
profile.summary:
Software engineer with 4 years of development and support experience. Experienced in Full software life cycle development, Object-Oriented Design and Analysis, testing, training, and maintenance. Proven results in ability to resolve critical issues, adhere to software process, manage documentation and adapt to new technical environments.

Specialties: C ++, C, JAVA, JavaScript, ExtJS 4, HTML, PHP, XML, C#, Visual Basic, Oracle, MYSQL,  Windows and Linux operating system.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for development and maintenance of HzERM Access Management. Duties consist of
development of entrerprise healthcare system in agile development environment, and providing critical
customer support.
Technical Environment: Windows, UNIX, Java, C#, ExtJs 4, XML, Oracle 9, Eclipse, Visual Studio.NET.; Consistently improved software quality and maintanability.
    
        Participated on a team that developed a process to decrease time in developer unit testing phase.
    
        Helped develop a site to centralize development environment information.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for C++ development and testing for the Kingbird Project. Duties consisted of developing,
testing, and integrating hardware and software for government end user application.
Technical Environment: Linux, C++, shell scripting, Qt4.

        Developed various tools and methods that increased system installation and testing efficiency.
    
        Maintained and constructed system documentation and procedures for system installation.
    
        Adhered to project security clearance protocols.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Responsible for teaching class that taught students the basics of how to use a computer, browse the world
wide web, and how to use Microsoft Office 2003. Duties consisted of providing bi-weekly lectures,
administering exams, grading assignments, and giving grades.

        Created effective teaching methods for each subject matter.
    
        Answered questions and maintained office hours for additional help for students.
